Increase user engagement with Jotform AI Agent & Chatbot! 

Revolutionize the way you interact with users with Jotform AI Agent & Chatbot – an intelligent customer-service solution that enhances engagement, automates responses, and streamlines data collection. Assist customers, validate inputs, and guide users through complex processes.

Why Jotform AI Agent & Chatbot?

Jotform AI Agents are more than just chatbots. They conduct real-time, personalized interactions that improve user satisfaction and drive efficiency. From handling inquiries to managing voice-based conversations, AI Agents ensure smooth, positive engagements across multiple platforms.

Key features and benefits

Real-time assistance: Instantly respond to user queries, automate customer support, and reduce wait times with AI-driven responses.
Manual chat takeover: Need human intervention? Seamlessly take over AI conversations in real time whenever needed, ensuring a perfect balance between automation and human support.
Intelligent data collection: Gather, validate, and organize information through conversational interactions.

Personalized user engagement: AI adapts to user behavior and preferences, ensuring customized responses and seamless experiences.
Multichannel support: Engage users across the web, chat, email, and even phone calls for a unified experience everywhere.
Voice-enabled interactions: Use advanced voice recognition to transcribe conversations, manage calls, and provide hands-free assistance.
Customizable workflows: Align AI Agents with your business goals with tailored workflows, branding, and automation.
24-7 availability: AI Agents work round the clock to ensure users get instant responses anytime, anywhere.

Elevate user experience with Jotform AI Agent & Chatbot! 

AI Agents simplify communication, reduce response times, and create an engaging user journey. AI Agents were designed to make life easier for businesses, customer support teams, and digital service providers. Whether you’re automating customer service, optimizing workflows, or building AI-powered forms, this tool ensures effortless and meaningful interactions.

Download now and transform the way you connect with your audience!
